title: Ultimate Aesthetics Bodybuilding Program v1.0
author: Ahmed S.
desc: Designed to focus on muscle groups that help with the V-taper as well as building a solid base in all key lifts

ex.note: Top set of 4-6 reps to get those juicy strength gains and then 3 backoff sets of 6-10 reps. Focus on full ROM.
2 sets of 8-12 reps, incline degree could vary according to physical attributes. After hitting failure with full ROM, go for partials in the stretched position.
4 sets of 6 to 10 reps. Before starting, do a few warm-upp sets. Focus on getting your elbows to your sides. Better with straps for intended rep range.
3 sets of 8 to 10 reps. Upon hitting failure, do partials in the stretched position and then do shrugs for your mid back to squeeze more gains out of the set.
Do the first set with more Body-English with a heavier weight and then do a lighter weight with a more strict scapular plane form and alternate between the two. The intended rep range is 12-15 reps.
3 sets of 8 to 10 reps. Adjust the seat for the handles to be in the middle of your forearm. A better variation is without holding. Just grind your forearm against the handle and do laterals.
Top set of 5-8 reps and then 2 back off sets of 7-10 reps.
Top set of 6 to 10 reps and then take off some weight to stay in the same rep range for your 2 backoff sets.
3 sets of 8 to 12 reps, in the last set, drop set with bodyweight squats till failure.
3 sets of 10 to 15 reps.
Top sets of 6 to 10 reps, and then take 10% off the bar for your other 2 back off sets to stay in the same rep range.
4 sets of 6 to 10 reps. Start strict and try to keep your elbows back unless there's a need to squeeze a rep with more body-english 😉
3 sets of 10 to 15 reps.
4 sets of 6 to 10 reps.
